changelog:
## Major update: Expanded audit framework and added detailed international SEO checks.

- Revised skill description for broader SEO audit triggers and clarified when to use related skills.
- Refactored audit instructions: Now includes step-by-step technical SEO, crawlability, indexation, site speed, and mobile-friendliness assessments.
- Introduced guidelines for context gathering and product marketing alignment before auditing.
- Added a comprehensive section on International SEO, including hreflang, multilingual canonicals, and international sitemaps (with error diagnostics).
- Clarified limitations in schema detection via standard fetch methods—now recommends accurate detection approaches.
- Added references directory for International SEO guidance.
summary: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," "SEO health check," "my traffic dropped," "lost rankings," "not showing up in Google," "site isn't ranking," "Google update hit me," "page speed," "core web vitals," "crawl errors," or "indexing issues." Use this even if the user just says something vague like "my SEO is bad" or "help with SEO" — start with an audit. For building pages at scale to target keywords, see programmatic-seo. For adding structured data, see schema. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.
